summary: Alithya Group inc filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, furnishing the report on voting results from its virtual annual general meeting held that day. Approximately 77.99% of votes attached to all outstanding shares as of the July 13, 2026 record date were represented. Shareholders elected all eight nominee directors, with each receiving a majority of votes cast; Pierre Turcotte drew the highest withheld percentage at 22.96%. KPMG LLP was reappointed auditor for fiscal 2027 with 94.68% support. No special-situation transaction, tender, activist campaign, or management change is disclosed.
